authority: Human Owner: test P=A+B with A=63/64 and B=1/64
question: Does a small Shadow Memory residual improve a dominant radial-Fourier metric on a larger fresh LIFE holdout?
dependency: CA-IDENT-03 frozen features and classifier; CA-IDENT-04 balancing failure
holdout_transform: quarter-turn id mod 4 plus fixed shift [5,-4]
classifier: deterministic standardized 3-nearest-neighbour with lexicographic tie break

view_roles.P: weighted concatenated metric after per-view coordinate standardization and per-view dimension normalization

metric_definition: d_P^2 = w_A * mean(z_A distance squared) + w_B * mean(z_B distance squared); implemented by multiplying each standardized coordinate by sqrt(w_view / dimension_view)
coverage_gate: Every behavior class present in training must have at least 10 holdout rows; if this fails, utility gates are not interpreted.
primary_gate: With coverage passing, P_63_1 macro-F1 must exceed fourier_A by at least 0.01 and must not reduce recall for any class with at least 10 holdout rows.
specificity_gate: P_63_1 must exceed both P_equal and P_1_63_reverse_control in macro-F1.
interpretation: 63/64 and 1/64 are tested only as declared mixture weights. The arithmetic identity P=A+B does not itself imply a physical, resonant or universal mechanism.
